_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: Adds record_compliance_scope (BI-0B867B67 phase 3): the compliance coworker captures what the business does with data / where it employs people into BusinessContext, moving matching regulations from needs-review to applies. Earns a permanent place — it is the conversational half of the setup-form capture and the only tool that writes the applicability-triggering profile; authority stays data_governance_validate-gated.

registry.packFiles.reason: Adds compliance-scope-pack (BI-0B867B67 phase 3) hosting record_compliance_scope in its own scoped pack per the pack-registry convention (one capability domain per pack), rather than bloating an unrelated pack. Permanent: it is the compliance coworkers capture surface.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Adds WWMD kernel discovery to core for peer CLIs (Grok/Codex): principle_decide + wiki_query. Those clients have no ToolSearch, so a lean core that omitted WWMD blocked AGENTS-required kernel consults even when the token already granted registry_read. Still lean vs full catalogue; authority stays grant/scope gated.
